vibe.rationale: Upgrade from July 8 morning Vibe 3, consistent with July 8 evening Vibe 4 trajectory. The analytical basis for the upgrade: (1) MOU formal status: Trump's declaratory 'over' language at NATO Ankara is maximum-pressure posture, not a termination instrument. The Witkoff/Kushner channel qualifier — 'they want to keep going, but they have to come back to me' — preserves the negotiator track that has resolved every prior escalation sequence in the 132-day arc. No SNSC formal MOU-void declaration. No naval blockade reinstatement. Kharg Island threatened, not struck — the single most significant stabilizer of the overnight session. (2) FOMC minutes dovish relative to pre-release 66% September hike odds: September probability recalibrated to ~50-55%; Warsh's stripped-guidance posture is more permissive than a hawkish dot submission would have been. (3) Chelan Hills 20% containment confirmed on Day 4 evening — materially improved from 0% on three prior mornings; Day 5 personnel build overnight with AR humidity providing final suppression assist before post-AR conditions arrive. Headwinds at Vibe 4: CENTCOM second-wave strikes and Iran's 85+ US-facility counter-strikes constitute the most geographically extensive military exchange of the post-MOU period — the formal 'no formal breach' reading co-exists with the operational worst-of-post-MOU. Sourdough AR window is now closed — Day 5 is the first post-AR assessment and the first morning when extended attack conditions govern the fire's trajectory. Measles high-consequence window opens today. Russia Omsk refinery halted (July 7) — dual-source energy shock deepening. Upgrade to Vibe 5 requires: formal Witkoff/Kushner negotiation resumption announcement or Iran-side SNSC statement affirming MOU continuation + Chelan Hills Day 5 ICS-209 advancing toward 40%+ + Sourdough any initial containment reading on Day 5 + September hike odds below 50%. Downgrade to Vibe 3 requires: SNSC formal MOU-void declaration citing oil sanctions reimposition as US breach + CENTCOM blockade reinstatement order under Kharg operation + Sourdough zero containment Day 5 with fire-perimeter threat to Skagit dam complex + Chelan Hills regression below 20%.

items.label: Russia Fuel Crisis Day 9 — Omsk Refinery Halted
items.summary: Russia fuel crisis Day 9. Omsk refinery — Russia's largest refinery and top domestic gasoline producer, processing approximately 20 million metric tons annually — halted operations July 7 after Ukrainian drone strikes July 6. Most consequential single infrastructure event of the crisis. Combined with prior strikes, approximately one-quarter to one-third of Russia's national refining capacity is offline. 78 of 83 internationally recognized Russian regions reporting fuel access disruption. Daily shortfall running approximately 20% below domestic demand. IEA 'unprecedented' designation. Sales rationed to 20-30 liters per vehicle. The June 17 FOMC meeting minutes (released yesterday) predate the Russia crisis onset — the committee's assessment does not incorporate this supply disruption. Dual-source energy shock (Hormuz re-escalation premium + Russia refining collapse) is the most complex global energy disruption since 2022.

analyst_summary: The morning of July 9 opens on a Vibe 4 — restored from July 8 morning's Vibe 3 downgrade, consistent with the July 8 evening's recovery trajectory. The analytical foundation for the Vibe 4 hold rests on three stabilizing reads confirmed since yesterday morning: first, the Witkoff/Kushner channel is explicitly preserved in Trump's own 'ceasefire over' statement ('Steve and Jared want to keep going — but they have to come back to me') and no formal termination instrument was issued despite CENTCOM executing its most geographically dispersed strike package of the post-MOU period; second, Kharg Island — through which 90% of Iran's oil exports transit — was threatened but not struck, which is the single most significant operational stabilizer of the overnight session; third, FOMC minutes tilted slightly dovish relative to the 66% pre-release September hike probability (recalibrated to ~50-55%), reducing the most acute market risk overhang from yesterday morning. Against these stabilizers: the CENTCOM second-wave + Iran's 85+ US-facility counter-strikes constitute the most geographically extensive military exchange of the 132-day post-MOU arc, and the Russia fuel crisis entered its most consequential phase with the Omsk halt — both developments occurred after the FOMC's June 17 meeting, meaning the committee's current frame is operating on stale energy-price and geopolitical assumptions that have materially deteriorated in the intervening three weeks. Today's primary watch items are: (1) the Chelan Hills Day 5 morning ICS-209 — will the 20% Day 4 evening reading hold and advance? (2) The Sourdough Day 5 morning ICS-209 — the first post-AR assessment, now under extended attack conditions; (3) whether Georgetown wastewater surveillance registers any signal as the Lumen Field cluster's high-consequence transmission window opens this morning; (4) final stakeholder filing volume for the FERC AI pathway intervention deadline closing COB today; and (5) any SNSC or Iranian Foreign Ministry formal characterization of whether the oil sanctions reimposition constitutes a MOU breach requiring formal SNSC void declaration — the single most escalatory possible outcome remaining on the table.
